actionClasses: llm-search-eval pull request comment publish command
description: Reviews llm-search-eval commands that act outside the local machine: `comment`, which posts or updates a GitHub pull request comment with a token, and `run` with --judge or --pairwise-judge, which sends queries and product text to a relevance judge such as an OpenAI-compatible API that may bill the account. `estimate`, `validate`, `report`, `gate`, `sample`, `comment --dry-run`, `--help` and `--version` are not matched.
name: llm-search-eval command protection
saferAlternatives: Add --dry-run to llm-search-eval comment to print the comment instead of posting it.
Run llm-search-eval estimate with the same options and set a budget with --max-cost.
